scope: One preregistered four-way partition of early future-to-current cuts in a common masked arithmetic background, fixed A195 and two V realizations at X+12cm. Higher layer groups are same-site-count comparisons, not known irrelevant semantic controls; equal 135-site budgets do not imply equal output perturbation. The old eighteen-layer primary remains rejected. Actual q0 inputs, full outputs and current/action boundaries only. Hard masking also renormalizes remaining attention; content and allocation effects are not separated. No training, new physics, semantic unit or neural root-cause claim.
